summary: The candidate bounds the reported dense MQA logits allocation for the tested RAGGED orchestration, but its chunked PAGED path incorrectly slices a global request page table by query-row chunk offsets while retaining global request row indices. The candidate regression does not exercise fused PAGED metadata. Full CUDA/B300 serving reproduction was unavailable.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before behavior of the candidate regression on the recorded base: 5 failed, 1 passed; the plan path made one call instead of three and returned the old unbounded budget.
Candidate regression plus existing MQA budget suite: 9 passed. DeepGEMM/top-k were mocked in the candidate's GPU regression.

Independent fused-top-k metadata equivalence and minimum-budget cases: 2 passed, 1 failed. RAGGED metadata and padding were preserved; PAGED failed because the second chunk received a sliced page table with global row indices.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2.26015. Candidate and adversarial orchestration allocated real FP8/device tensors, but mocked DeepGEMM and top-k kernels.

remaining_counterexamples: With SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK enabled and TopkTransformMethod.PAGED, a later query-row chunk slices ragged_paged_page_table by query offsets while passing global ragged_paged_page_table_row_index values, breaking dense/chunked equivalence and potentially indexing outside the sliced table.
If total_k_rows * 4 exceeds the computed logits budget, query-only chunking cannot honor the budget because the minimum chunk is one full concatenated-K output row.
remaining_limitations: No four-B300 CUDA TP=4/EP=4 environment, NVIDIA DeepGEMM, GLM-5.3-Flash/RadixArk weights, 300K-1M token traffic, hierarchical cache, or DFLASH serving reproduction was available.
The actual DeepGEMM allocation and actual fused top-k kernel were not run on this ROCm device; the independent failure checks the Python orchestration contract and tensor coordinate spaces.
The exact original 73.65 GiB allocation therefore remains unverified in this architecture, although the base regression establishes the dead/unapplied chunking behavior.
